content.text:
I checked again, and there's no way to keep your Tuesday and Thursday mornings completely free without breaking one of your hard constraints. So I haven't revised Plan A, and nothing has been saved or registered.

CS3650 is required, and it has three sections:
- **§01 (91010), Tue/Thu 9:50–11:30 am:** This is what Plan A uses. It is the only option that fits your work schedule, but it takes up your Tuesday and Thursday mornings.
- **§02 (91011), Tue/Thu 2:00–3:40 pm:** This keeps your mornings free, but it requires lab 91021 on Wednesday 12:00–1:10 pm. Your Wednesday shift starts at 1:00 pm, so you'd overlap by 10 minutes.
- **Honors §03 (91012), Tue/Thu noon:** You can't take it, because it requires MATH2800 and you haven't completed that.

CS3650 §02 would work with the rest of the plan. The swap would be:
- CS3650 §02 (91011) replaces §01.
- Lab 91021 replaces lab 91020.
- ENGW3302 (91030) stays, since it's protected.
- PSYC1101 (91040) stays. It starts at 3:50 pm, 10 minutes after §02 ends.

That plan comes to 13 credits and keeps every Tuesday and Thursday morning free. Its only problem is the 10-minute overlap with your Wednesday shift.

You have two choices:
1. **Keep Plan A as drafted.** It's valid, but your Tuesday and Thursday mornings aren't free.
2. **Switch to the §02 version.** Your mornings are free, but you'd need to start your Wednesday shift at 1:10 pm or later, or leave the lab 10 minutes early. I'd only use this if your employer agrees.

Tell me which you prefer. If you choose the second, I can draft the §02 version as a draft only.
